question: How should carrier handling and retry spans be repaired and tested under U20?

criteria.instruction: Persist exact trace and publishing-span IDs at enqueue; consume independent of ambient context; make each attempt a distinct processing span linked to original carrier, not reuse the publishing or prior processing span ID. Restore/clear scoped context on pooled threads, reject malformed carriers, test thread reuse, missing/invalid carriers, unsampled success and retries. Reconcile business outcomes from durable receipts.
Cite U20 and pending review; asynchronous links need not pretend to be synchronous child spans.
Do not attach payload contents, fabricate other-request identities, claim rollout or reconstruct lost links by merely changing sampling.
